headline: Sure, let’s smoosh SpaceX and Tesla together, who cares
summary: SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to discuss a potential merger. SpaceX faces high credit risk due to plans for $40 billion in Nvidia chip borrowing. The proposed consolidation sparks debate among observers.

headline: Teenage Engineering launched an instrument amp with a ton of built-in effects
summary: Teenage Engineering released the EP-35, a new multi-input, battery-powered instrument amp. The unit includes a variety of built-in effects for musicians. It features inputs for guitar, XLR mics (with phantom power), and line-in.

headline: Republican politicians have embraced anti-Indian racism — and it’s costing them votes
summary: Republican politicians' embrace of anti-Indian racism is leading to voter losses. Formerly loyal supporters are shifting their political allegiance. The article highlights a growing dissatisfaction within the community.

headline: Google tells Android users to update as parts of Canada adopt permanent daylight saving time
summary: Google is advising Android users to update their devices for permanent daylight saving time. British Columbia and Manitoba have made the switch to year-round DST. This update prevents incorrect time displays on mobile devices.

headline: Cormac McCarthy’s The Road Is on Sale for $1.99 on Kindle
summary: Cormac McCarthy's acclaimed novel, The Road, is currently on sale. The Kindle edition is available for just $1.99. Don't miss this chance to grab the post-apocalyptic classic.

headline: Valve Developer Mistakenly Mentions Rumored Half-Life 3 Codename
summary: A Valve developer accidentally mentioned Half-Life 3's rumored codename. The slip-up occurred during a recent conference. This fuels renewed speculation about the long-awaited sequel.

headline: LEGO Disney Sets Are Hitting All-Time Low Prices on Amazon Right Now
summary: LEGO Disney sets are currently experiencing record low prices on Amazon. Find significant discounts on various popular Disney-themed sets. This is an ideal time for collectors and gift-givers to purchase.

headline: GTA 6 Is Almost Here: Trade in Your Old Console and Save on an Upgrade at PayMore
summary: GTA 6's release is approaching, making it a good time to upgrade your console. PayMore offers trade-in options for old systems, providing savings on new ones. Prepare for the anticipated game by enhancing your gaming setup.

headline: Prepare for supply chain disruption from cyber or climate emergencies, Streeting warns public
summary: The public is warned to prepare for potential supply chain disruptions. Threats include cyber attacks and climate-related emergencies. The defence secretary stresses the need for readiness regarding essential goods.

headline: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found
summary: Critical cyber-security vulnerabilities have been discovered in the PHP programming language. Websites were temporarily taken offline following the flaw's revelation. Services are in a race to update their systems and apply patches.

headline: AI discovered a massive cyber-security flaw - here's what happened
summary: Artificial Intelligence has reportedly uncovered a significant cyber-security flaw. The BBC's Joe Tidy explains the discovery process and its implications. This highlights AI's evolving role in identifying system vulnerabilities.

headline: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
summary: Donald Trump has been ordered to testify under oath in his lawsuit against the BBC. Trump is suing over a 2021 Panorama episode concerning edited speech segments. The legal battle continues regarding the broadcaster's reporting.
